grades.quote: The other processes will find that, despite being woken up, there is no data to be read. From their point of view the wakeup was “spurious,” and they must sleep again. For this reason sleep is always called inside a loop that re-checks the condition, as in P above.
grades.reason: Directly explains that waking does not guarantee the condition holds, so a loop must recheck it and wait again if necessary.
